notes.title: Fruits Icon Pack is now live 🍍
notes.content:
[h2]The fruits are all set and ready to be found[/h2][hr][/hr][p]So far in Infinite Seek and Find you’ve had the chance to spot items like colorful butterflies and a variety of flowers, but we know that true search connoisseurs want more! Finding them is already a joy, but to make the experience even better, we’ve added a new selection of bright, fragrant, and irresistibly tasty fruits to the pool of discoveries. With today's update, they're coming straight to your screen.[/p][p][/p][h2]How it was?[/h2][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363195/3ce8d18650c6d17f6815d3450d1f8dd2699aa41f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A sample scene you know and love! A picture full of interesting objects such as toys, clocks, robots, and globes - and among them those that you have to move forward. Only a sharp eye can take on this challenge… and now it just got even bigger! 👇[/p][p][/p][h2]And how it is now with additional Fruit levels[/h2][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363195/194d09c4be1d89729c5964414c156515b018be81.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Just look at the wide range of smiling, surprised or shocked fruits - they're begging to be clicked! Will you be able to find the right icons in this colorful crowd and choose them from among other delicacies? Dive into fresh levels and discover even more ways to relax with today’s update![/p][p][/p][h3]Have fun, seekers!
[/h3]

notes.title: Nora is a bit late, but finally here!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Nora is (as usual) being a bit of a klutz, so the game got a bit delayed due to some last-minute technical issues.

But, it's finally here and we really hope you like this alternative version of Nora's adventures!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859820/Nora_In_Search_of_Hidden_Ingredients/

We will also try to release the latest chapter for the original Nora game sometime in early June!

notes.title: A New Beginning for Nora!
notes.content:
After we first announced the demo of the Nora-themed HO story we've heard people complain there's not enough substance to it and simply placing items in the game locations doesn't give enough of a game.

We've heard you, so Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients got her own story now, while still keeping the HO elements. And today we present you a new demo! We'll be happy to hear your opinions!

For those of you waiting on the main Nora story - we are currently working on it and will likely have something to share in 1-2 months!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859820/Nora_In_Search_of_Hidden_Ingredients/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/2222e55459f86508394ac1dcf45206909e3ba9bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome Leadlight!
notes.content:

notes.title: Infinite Seek and Find 1.03
notes.content:
Get ready to take your hidden object adventures to new heights! Update 1.03 is packed with exciting new features and challenges to keep you engaged for hours.

[h2]New modes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Test your skills with two new grayscale modes that will put your observation abilities to the ultimate test.
[*] Find an undetermined number of identical items before moving on.
[*] Look for matching halves of objects scattered throughout the image.
[*] After finding an object, watch as the remaining items either mix up or fall into place.
[/list]
[h2]More Objects to Find:[/h2]
We've added new items to discover across our diverse image sets. With even more variety, you'll never run out of things to find.

Prepare to be challenged like never before!
